Research focus: Dynamic placement of edge-AI application tasks
Method: Containerized video pipeline with frame extraction, parallel object-detection services, and frame combination
Workload or data: Video object detection; varies video quality and detection-container count
Hardware and network assumptions: Reported deployment uses Raspberry Pi for frame extraction and MacBook Pro and Asus systems for detection services; Kubernetes cluster
Verified finding: More detection containers reduce processing time up to a workload-dependent threshold; beyond it, processing time can increase
Limitation or scope caution: One application and deployment; video quality affects processing time and communication between services
Relevance to this project: Motivates measuring both parallel processing benefit and inter-stage communication cost

Method: Survey and taxonomy covering AI for edge and AI on edge
Hardware and network assumptions: No single experimental hardware or network setup
Verified finding: Organizes edge-intelligence goals, architectures, and research challenges
Limitation or scope caution: Survey conclusions depend on the literature and scope reviewed; it is not a new benchmark
Relevance to this project: Provides conceptual framework and terminology, not an experimental baseline

Research focus: Distributed CNN inference across heterogeneous edge devices
Method: DistrEdge uses deep reinforcement learning to select model partitioning and device assignments
Workload or data: CNN inference with variation in device types and network bandwidth
Hardware and network assumptions: Experiments include embedded NVIDIA Jetson devices and varied Wi-Fi bandwidth; memory constraint is not modeled
Evaluation metrics: Images per second, latency, speedup against baseline methods
Verified finding: Reports 1.1--3x speedup over the best-performing baseline in evaluated cases
Limitation or scope caution: Results depend on tested models, devices, network conditions, and baselines; memory constraints are excluded
Relevance to this project: Candidate inference approach; future tests should include memory and communication costs

Method: Federated averaging aggregates locally computed model updates
Workload or data: Five model architectures and four datasets, including unbalanced and non-IID data settings
Hardware and network assumptions: Mobile clients motivate the method; detailed hardware and network assumptions require full-text extraction
Evaluation metrics: Communication rounds relative to synchronized stochastic gradient descent
Verified finding: Reports 10--100x fewer communication rounds in the evaluated settings
Limitation or scope caution: Training result tied to the evaluated models, datasets, and comparison baseline; not a distributed-inference result
Relevance to this project: Provides a primary federated-training baseline and illustrates communication cost
